data.one_liner: A flexible, customizable notification bar widget replacing Snackbars and Toasts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a highly customizable notification banner widget that can be displayed at the top or bottom of the screen. Supports custom animations, gradients, icons, action buttons, progress indicators, and remote notification triggering via FlushKit.
use_when: You need rich, highly customizable notification bars or snackbars in your app.
You want to support swipe-to-dismiss, action buttons, or embedded form inputs inside notifications.
You need to trigger remote notifications from your backend via FlushKit.
avoid_when: You require traditional system-level push notifications via APNs/FCM without relying on an external service like FlushKit.
You need a simple native toast message without UI customization.
strengths: Extremely customizable design, colors, gradients, and animations.
Supports local usage as well as remote SSE-based push notifications via FlushKit.
Includes helpful factory methods via FlushbarHelper for common patterns.
weaknesses: Remote notification features rely on a third-party service (FlushKit).
Can require careful context handling when triggered from various parts of the app.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. For remote notifications, initialize FlushbarRemote in your root widget.
